stem: Which line from the poem best shows that the mother squirrel is kind?

options.label: F
options.text: A gust of wind blew down her nest. (line 2)

options.label: G
options.text: With pulsing tail and twitching nose, (line 3)

options.label: H
options.text: A baby squirrel just half her size (line 7)

options.label: J
options.text: She gently tucks her baby in (line 11)
